findings.title: Redundant setup zeroing
findings.detail: inverse=zeros(Int,N) is followed by _basis_inverse! fill!(inverse,0). One avoidable N-entry zeroing pass at phase setup; no additional allocation or retained storage, no hot-path effect. Vector{Int}(undef,N) could remove it later because validator initializes all entries before reads. This does not block exact component admission or justify a benchmark.
